title: Baker Mayfield on playing Browns: Ultimately, you remember the good more than the bad

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Baker Mayfield on playing Browns: Ultimately, you remember the good more than the bad
sources.description: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield has had Sunday’s game circled since the schedule release in the spring, as Tampa Bay will host Cleveland — the team that drafted him No. 1 overall in 2018.
